title: Ledger Component and ADR Reference ORM Mapping
objective: Map ComponentReference and ArchitectureDecisionReference to the selected API SQLAlchemy Base using their A1b2 natural identities and statically verify PostgreSQL metadata without database operations.
scope: Exactly two API-Base reference ORM records in the explicit quantmind2 schema.
Natural composite primary keys, restrictive Run foreign keys, domain-derived enum checks, ADR format validation, and nonduplicative indexes.
Dialect-only PostgreSQL DDL compilation, targeted tests, reference ORM contract, Project Memory updates, and one independent local commit.
explicit_non_goals: No Limitation or RecommendedTask ORM mapping and no technical reference IDs.
No Component Catalog or ADR entity foreign key, relationship collection, upsert, merge, or overwrite behavior.
No Domain-to-ORM mapper, production Repository, Session, Unit of Work, transaction, database connection, credentials, migration, schema or table creation, or executed DDL.
No Manifest Parser or Indexer, Git consistency service, API, UI, TDX, Dataset Snapshot, Factor DSL, Optimization, Validation runtime, Registry, LightGBM, or Qlib change.
No Factor Lab, dependency, lockfile, runtime configuration, accepted ADR, historical Implementation Run, or A2a2b2 change.

known_limitations: Limitation and RecommendedTask ORM mappings remain absent.
No Domain/ORM mapper, migration, schema/table creation, live PostgreSQL, production Repository, Session, Unit of Work, transaction, Parser/Indexer, Git consistency service, API, or UI exists.
Component Catalog membership, ADR document existence/status, and business relation truth are not database-validated.
Static DDL compilation used SQLAlchemy 2.0.51 while production requirements pin 2.0.25.
Context and Manifest schema v1 cannot encode exact next task QM2-P0-002A2a2b2 in machine recommended-task arrays, so legal parents QM2-P0-002 and QM2-P0-002A2 are used there.
The containing commit cannot be embedded self-referentially; Git history resolves it after commit.
unresolved_questions: How should a future Indexer surface a missing Component Catalog entry or ADR document without making PostgreSQL authoritative?
How will a future Repository distinguish composite-key exact replay from immutable conflict without an unsafe upsert?
How will pinned SQLAlchemy 2.0.25 and an isolated PostgreSQL fixture be supplied?
rollback_information: Revert the single containing commit. No database, schema, migration, data, API, runtime, model, Qlib, UI, dependency, lockfile, configuration, accepted ADR, or Factor Lab rollback is required.
security_impact: ORM metadata contains no credentials and import performs no filesystem, environment, network, Git, engine, session, connection, or DDL operation; domain identifier and secret boundaries remain authoritative.
data_lineage_impact: No research data changed; two reference metadata targets prepare a future derived Ledger query index while Git Component Catalog, ADR documents, Reports, and Manifests remain authoritative.
